Cellular Respiration 
Cellular respiration results in net gain of 36-38 ATP molecules per glucose, depending on the cell
explanation: This slide notes the overall energy yield of aerobic cellular respiration. Complete breakdown of one molecule of glucose results in a net gain of 36 to 38 ATP molecules, with the exact amount depending on the specific cell type.

questions.q: What is the net gain of ATP molecules per glucose molecule from complete cellular respiration?
